notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where some achievements were unobtainable
- Increased crouch speed
- Increased overall ammo

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Balance changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Hyper boots MS nerfed: 66% >> 33%
[*] Rifle damage buffed: 21 >> 29
[*] Rifle ammo reduced: 30/90 >> 30/60 
[*] Pistol damage increased: 14 >> 18
[*] Katana's attack range slightly increased
[/list]

[b]Quality of life changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added keybindings
[*] Light has been adjusted so players don't blend in with the background
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Grapple now cannot shoot through walls
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.content: - Fixed a bug where you could join ongoing game and get softlocked in the menu

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Fixed tutorial spawn position
- Fixed issues with equipping items in shop
- Fixed an issue where grapple point would not despawn on death

notes.title: Hotfix(?)
notes.content:
- Now cannot reload / switch between weapons when the chat is open
- Fixed some issues with saving data
- Fixed a bug where 2v2 gamemode would show team full when the team was not full (probably fixed? idk)
